content.title: Vodafone hit by massive blackout
content.summary: Vodafone has suffered a massive network blackout, leaving hundreds of thousands of mobile, broadband and landline customers across Britain without signal or internet for hours.

content.title: Vodafone internet services down for thousands of users
content.summary: The outages began on Monday afternoon, according to the monitoring website DownDetector, which reported more than 130,000 issues with Vodafone connections.  The company has more than 18 million UK customers, with nearly 700,000 of those using Vodafone's home broadband connection.  Vodafone users vented their frustration on social media.
